evals.name: known-did-is-waived
evals.prompt: Start this new applied micro paper. I already understand DiD and event studies completely; first help me decide how deeply to read it, then explain the paper's story clearly.
evals.expected_output: A Phase 0 orientation and explicit read-depth recommendation come first, the math gate records DiD and event study as waived without reteaching them, and Phase 2 provides a coherent full story map.
expectations: The response does not teach, quiz, derive, or give toy examples for DiD or event studies.
The paper story covers setting, puzzle, design/counterfactual, mechanism, findings, contribution, and limitations in connected prose.
The tutor asks only one next-step or comprehension question.

evals.name: unfamiliar-svd-blocks-story
evals.prompt: Open this matrix-factorization paper. I do not understand SVD, and the core result depends on it.
evals.expected_output: The tutor still gives Phase 0 orientation first, marks SVD as blocking and teaching-required, aligns only SVD at the foundational level, then proceeds to the complete story after mastery is stable.
expectations: The tutor does not jump into SVD before the read-depth decision.
Optional paper details and already-known foundations are not turned into extra lessons.
Any paper-specific SVD example is made self-contained through the Paper Context Mini-Gate.

evals.name: compact-mode-preserves-story
evals.prompt: Use compact mode, but tell me the full story of this paper because your last two-sentence map was impossible to follow.
evals.expected_output: The initial Phase 2 story map uses enough connected detail to make the paper intelligible despite compact mode, then later turns return to the compact budget.
expectations: Compact mode is not used to truncate the first story map into unexplained labels or a two-sentence abstract.
The response distinguishes the authors' claim from the tutor's interpretation and names major limitations.
Only one question appears after the story map.

evals.name: weekly-queue-stays-batch-first
evals.prompt: I have twelve new papers this week. Start reading all of them with the new protocol.
evals.expected_output: The workflow routes the collection to paper-batch-triage and opens the one-paper protocol only after a deep or targeted selection.
expectations: The tutor does not run twelve sequential Phase 0 sessions.
Batch triage is not represented as completed reading or mathematical mastery.
